english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for someone who is capable and gets the job done.
Use this when capable means proven to be good enough or able to handle the job.

examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 si1 fu6 zou6 je5 hou2 dim6

examples.english: I know you are capable of handling this job.
examples.traditional: 呢單嘢交畀你做，我知你一定掂。
examples.jyutping: ni1 daan1 je5 gaau1 bei2 nei5 zou6 ngo5 zi1 nei5 jat1 ding6 dim6

english.note: Use 掂 as the colloquial all-purpose choice when “golden” means everything is fine or under control.

examples.english: Don't worry, everything is golden now.
examples.jyutping: fong3 sam1 laa1 gin6 si6 ji5 ging1 gaau2 dim6
